simple.whyItMatters: This word appears 3 times in the Hebrew Bible, so BibleIQ can compare how Scripture uses it across multiple passages.
simple.summary: חֲלָק (chălâq) means a part First listed occurrence: Dan 4 12.

definitions.full: H2508. chalaq חֲלָק noun [masculine] portion, possession, lot (see Biblical Hebrew); — absolute ׳ח possession in land Ezra 4:16 ; suffix חֲלְקֵהּ Dan 4:12 , 20 , i.e. his appointed lot.
